title: Tunisian Chicken Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired dish featuring roasted chicken, juicy spices, and a nutty pilaf.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breast for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, heat the pilaf according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pilaf, roasted spices, and chopped parsley.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve the sliced chicken on top of the pilaf mixture.
Garnish with additional parsley and tunisian chili peppers if desired.
